description: A subset H of X is homogeneous in colour i for c when every n-element subset of H receives i, including vacuous homogeneity when H has fewer than n elements.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.IsHomogeneousIn.{u, v} {α : Type u} {K : Type v} {n : ℕ}
  (c : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.Coloring α n K) (H : Set α) (i : K) : Prop
